title: The Sleeping Yard
synopsis: The lighthouse goes dark, and the Hush walks out of the sea. Rook can't outrun it, so he hides the last train among a hundred sleeping ones.
note: The last train runs again tomorrow.
lines: Harbor run, passengers. Hold the bar.
The lighthouse... it just went dark.
The track lamps too. It's coming.
It's too close! We can't outrun it.
The old yard. So many sleeping trains.
Lights off. Now we are one of them.
...It's looking right at us. Don't move.
Old Nine? You still have steam?
Thank you, old friend. Quiet wheels.
It will come again. We'll be ready.
Next stop, the harbor. Lights ahead!
